rules.statement: Section 34 of the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance bars the acquisition of prescriptive title to temple land that had not been acquired prior to 1931.
rules.supporting_quote: Where title by prescription to Buddhist temple land had not been acquired prior to 1931, section 34 of the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance bars the acquisition of prescriptive title to temple land.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 34 of the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance (Cap. 318)

meta.parties: Piyaratane Thero v. Jothiya and Another
